reuse.why: The new getDateWithWeekendRule wraps the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend and every caller (getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, schedule-template) switches to it.

duplication.why: The repeated skipWeekend ternary in schedule-template is folded into a local helper; only the occurrence-scanning pattern (take a window, keep the first non-null) appears in both getNextDate and getUpcomingDates.

placement.why: The weekend rule sits in shared/schedules.ts beside getDateWithSkippedWeekend, and frequency is carried on the RSchedule data where skipWeekend already lives.

scope.why: Only the weekend-handling paths and their tests are touched.

maintainability.why: One rule function with an explicit null-means-skip contract is easy to own, though the DAILY_SCAN_WINDOW multiplier applied to all frequencies in getUpcomingDates is a slightly opaque coupling.

bypasses_abstraction.where: none; all former getDateWithSkippedWeekend callers go through getDateWithWeekendRule

one_place.where: shared/schedules.ts getDateWithWeekendRule, used by getNextDate, schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and budget/schedule-template.ts
